visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: Article utility row under the story header: 'Share' label with X/Facebook/LinkedIn/email icons, a 'Download assets' select-style dropdown, and a blue pill 'Subscribe to AT&T News' button, in one row between thin grey rules. Stacks on mobile.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Article utility row with share links, a download-assets dropdown and a subscribe button
visualCharacteristics.description: One row, three cells: share icons | download dropdown | subscribe pill button

contentPattern.summary: Fixed set of three different items side by side in one row that never wraps (share icons, download-assets dropdown, subscribe button); share links and the dropdown are interactive and the block builds share URLs from the page URL.
contentPattern.structure: one row with three cells: cell 1 the label 'Share' and a list of share links or network names (X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Email); the block rebuilds each share URL from the current page URL and title. Cell 2 the dropdown label (e.g. 'Download assets') as a paragraph followed by a list of download links (e.g. 'Download release (PDF)'). Cell 3 a single link (e.g. 'Subscribe to AT&T News'), rendered as a button

usage.description: Share/download/subscribe utility row under the headline of newsroom story pages.

reuseGuidance: Use for the story-page share/download/subscribe row. For general side-by-side content use columns.
